annotations.title: Market stress gate: credit, volatility, rates

description: Is it time to reduce risk or hedge? Credit, volatility and rate stress in one call. Returns the Regime Card stress gate: the overall state (Calm, Elevated or Stressed), how many of its three components are confirmed (N of 3), and the state of each component (Credit, Volatility, Rates: Clear or Confirmed). The levels behind the states stay private. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Recomputed hourly during the US session. "stale" is true when a scheduled update is missing. Useful when an agent needs a market stress or market risk check on credit, volatility and rates before it acts.
